how: uv run python tools/mutants.py docs/quantities/qt-b1/mutants.json --no-baseline --evidence docs/quantities/qt-b1/evidence/mutants-run.json, after a passing `lake build VE.Scales.Examples`; each mutant is applied alone, the module and its imports are built, the file is restored. The claim names the theorem or #guard the build stops at. The `-guard` twins rebuild only `VE.Scales.Premises` with the mutant and elaborate `Examples.lean` against the Theorems olean already built, so a fixture, not a proof, must fail; the kill is the first error line of Examples.
